rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a loud cry or outburst.

example.english: The whole stadium let out a shout when the team scored.
example.traditional: 入波嗰刻，全場爆出一陣喊聲。
example.jyutping: jap6 bo1 go2 hak1 cyun4 coeng4 baau3 ceot1 jat1 zan6 haam3 seng1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese verb for crying out loudly or calling out to get someone's attention.

example.english: Why do you shout so loudly?
example.jyutping: nei5 zou6 mat1 giu3 gam3 daai6 seng1 aa3
